findings.problem: Production unsafe with std::mem::transmute used to convert [u8; 4] to u32. Holzman Rust core contract forbids all production unsafe.
findings.failure_mode: transmute has zero documented guarantees for byte-order semantics; on different endianness platforms the returned u32 value will silently differ, producing corrupted length values with no error path
findings.fix: Replace transmute with explicit endianness-aware conversion: u32::from_le_bytes or u32::from_be_bytes, returning a Result<u32, InvalidLengthError> to handle short inputs

findings.problem: Unchecked indexing input[0], input[1], input[2], input[3] on a raw slice with no bounds check before access.
findings.failure_mode: Any input shorter than 4 bytes causes immediate panic at runtime, turning untrusted/external input into a denial-of-service vector instead of a typed error
findings.fix: Use input.get(0..4).and_then(|s| s.try_into().ok()).map(u32::from_le_bytes) and return Result<T, E> to handle short inputs gracefully

findings.problem: Public function read_len returns u32 directly with no fallible path, encoding two failure conditions (too-short input, endianness ambiguity) into silent panic or silent misinterpretation.
findings.failure_mode: Callers cannot distinguish between 'input too short' and 'input was valid but platform-endianness mismatch'; both manifest as incorrect behavior or panic, violating the principle that invalid states should be rejected by fallible constructors
findings.fix: Return Result<u32, ReadLenError> with a domain-typed error enum covering TooShort and (optionally) EndiannessMismatch; use explicit from_le_bytes/from_be_bytes

findings.problem: Function is declared pub but is not pure: it panics on short input and has platform-dependent behavior via transmute, violating the pure deterministic core requirement.
findings.failure_mode: The core cannot be deterministically tested or reasoned about; the same input on two different architectures produces different outputs or panics
findings.fix: Move endianness decision to the imperative shell boundary; core function takes an explicitly-endian u32 or returns Result with a deterministic pure implementation
